_comment: stoiclife Phase 2 config. Thresholds are expressed as deltas vs the rolling baseline, not absolute cutoffs. Tune here, not in code.
_coaching_sessions_comment: FEAT-04: which sessions may FIRE a coaching push. Morning is deliberately excluded — at 07:30 the day's Fitbit data is still stale (the device's overnight upload + the 10:00 catch-up sync haven't landed), so a morning coach reply would advise off yesterday's body. A morning eval still runs and logs an audit row, but with fired=0 so cooldown_active() stays clear and the 11:00 safety-net can fire on fresh data. The 11:00 sweep (freshest Fitbit) and the evening entry are the coaching moments. FEAT-05 exception: see late_morning — a morning entry written after that sweep has already run fires immediately, because the window it would defer to has closed.

late_morning._comment: FEAT-05: rescues the day when a morning-prep entry is written AFTER the 11:00 safety-net has already run. That sweep found no journal entry and logged insufficient_data, and it never runs again — so under FEAT-04's morning exclusion alone the entry deferred coaching to a window that had already closed and nothing was ever delivered (the 2026-08-11 miss). Past this cutoff a morning entry is treated as the safety-net run: coaching may fire and the 🟢/⚠️ status line may be appended. The cutoff is the safety-net hour precisely because that is the 'has the 10:00 catch-up sync landed' boundary — the data-freshness worry behind the morning exclusion is gone by then. Applies to TODAY only (a back-dated morning entry is never coached retroactively) and never to an early 07:30 prep, which still carries zero stoiclife output. Set enabled=false to restore strict FEAT-04 behaviour.

quiet_hours._comment: FEAT-04: held_max_age_days bounds the quiet-hours hold-and-release (Decision B: deliver once, the next morning). The start-of-run sweep releases a hold only if its date is within this many days and expires anything older (never delivers month-late coaching); combined with deliver-once marking in stoiclife_run.py (mark_hold_released), this prevents an un-cleared CLARIFY hold from wedging the morning + 11:00 sweep — the 2026-06-20 → 08-05 outage.

sleep_score._comment: FEAT-01 Part A: self-computed nightly sleep score (0-100). Targets recalibrated 2026-06-16 to Mihajlo's real distribution (avg dur 442, REM ~20%, eff ~0.97) so the score has dynamic range. REM uses straight rem_pct/target. state_bias_points (matrix modulation) is added in Step A3.

spo2._comment: FEAT-01 Part B: blood-oxygen (SpO2) modulator. Source: Google Health daily-oxygen-saturation (not the Fitbit Web API — see B0 findings). Evaluates yesterday's measured SpO2 (the freshest post-sleep value) against a fixed baseline; the 7-day rolling avg (nulls excluded) is surfaced for monitoring/self-calibration. Flag = abs floor OR drop>=threshold below baseline. Wellness signal, not a medical reading. state_bias_points modulates the matrix (Step B3). Issue-02 (2026-06-17): static baseline kept (SpO2 is floor-like, not relative like HRV — a drifting baseline would mask a sustained decline) but recalibrated to Mihajlo's actual avg (~95.6) with a tightened drop; prior 96/2/94 fired 0/16 nights (baseline at top of his 94.2–96.5 range, relative arm collapsed onto the 94 floor). Now 95.5/0.7/92 fires on the low-night cluster (<=94.8, ~4/16); floor 92 is the rare genuine-concern net. Drift is visible in the rolling avg (weekly review) — nudge baseline if his norm shifts.

weekend_recap._comment: Decision F: flag-gated weekend positive recap when the week skews Sweet Spot/stable.

manual_mood._comment: FEAT-03: lets Mihajlo set mood inline at the start of a journal entry (e.g. 'evening review: mood 7 — ...'), overriding inference. Parsed in save_entry.py (Step 2): ^mood\s*:?\s*(\d{1,2})\b, case-insensitive, start-anchored. Valid 1-10 => mood_score=N, mood_source='manual', token stripped; out-of-range/malformed/absent => fall back to inference (validate, don't clamp). Manual always wins — update_entry.py must never overwrite a manual score.

status_signal._comment: FEAT-02: appends a health-checked status line to the silent-day Stoic coach reply so silence is legible. 🟢 all ok = eval ran + biometrics fresh + last night's sleep_score present; ⚠️ heads up otherwise (never a false 'all ok'). spo2_soft_check keeps SpO2 informational — NULL is normal some nights and must not downgrade to a warning. ok_emoji deliberately differs from the ✅ 'Stoic entry saved' tick. GRACE WINDOW (added 2026-06-20): on today's row (lag 0) a NULL sleep_score before sleep_score_grace_until is treated as 'pending', not ⚠️ — the 07:00 primary sync usually beats Fitbit's overnight upload, so the score isn't derived until the 10:00 catch-up sync; a journal entry in that gap was drawing a false warning. Cutoff sits between the 10:00 catch-up and the 11:00 safety-net, so a genuinely stuck recompute still warns at/after 11:00 and every evening. sleep_grace_enabled=false restores strict behaviour.
status_signal._in_turn_sessions_comment: FEAT-04: which in-turn sessions may append the 🟢/⚠️ status line. Morning was dropped (was morning+evening) so the 07:30 morning-prep reply carries ZERO stoiclife output — no coaching push (see coaching_sessions) and no status line. Evening keeps it. The 11:00 safety-net is out-of-turn and never appended a line. FEAT-05 exception: a morning entry past late_morning.cutoff appends the line anyway (it is the safety-net run, so its silence must be legible); early morning preps are unaffected.
